intro: Privacy risks are escalating alongside AI capabilities, with experts warning of mounting security threats in the artificial intelligence era. OpenAI's Tamara Scarlett Miller advocates for using AI to reclaim time for personal priorities, though other professionals caution against over-relying on AI for career decisions. Claude demonstrated potential in drug discovery by autonomously designing protein binders effective against 14 of 15 disease targets, while Hugging Face attracts acquisition interest valuing the AI platform at $13 billion.
